target_claim_scope: The public_claim_status field applies only to v0.4.0. Prior released claims are recorded under prior_release_history and are not automatic admissions for v0.4.0.
claim_admission_rule: A v0.4.0 public claim is permitted only when its record is verified, admitted for the exact release, and has an accountable-human approval reference.
contradiction_refusal_rule: When records conflict or a critical fact is unknown, forbid the affected public claim, stop the affected consequential action, and request accountable-human review.

capabilities.promise: Classifies supported research-work requests, loads only relevant route guidance, and stops for accountable-human control at consequential boundaries.
capabilities.non_promise: Does not determine scientific, clinical, ethics, compliance, or publication facts or decisions.
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Do not infer a research decision from task classification; stop and request the relevant evidence or accountable-human approval.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: Re-admission for v0.4.0 requires an exact candidate evidence and human approval review.

capabilities.promise: Previews and, after matching human confirmation, creates an allowlisted empty workspace scaffold and provenance receipt.
capabilities.non_promise: Does not import data, alter an existing project, advance a project state, or authorize research work.
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Refuse an unsafe path, nonempty target, mismatched plan, missing approval reference, overwrite request, or scope beyond an empty scaffold.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: Re-admission for v0.4.0 requires exact-candidate helper, negative-boundary, and profile evidence.

capabilities.promise: Declares standalone and framework-integrated profiles with an explicit framework contract and exact validation target.
capabilities.non_promise: Does not promise compatibility with every platform, agent, workspace, framework release, or private environment.
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Do not infer profile support from similar folder names, an untagged framework checkout, or private workspace structure.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: Re-admission for v0.4.0 requires exact-tag integration evidence for the final candidate.

capabilities.promise: Provides a route and blank register for human-reviewed project retrospective and lesson-promotion work.
capabilities.non_promise: Does not automatically promote a project observation into shared memory, a system rule, or public material.
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Do not treat a retrospective note or candidate lesson as a reusable instruction without accountable-human review.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: Re-admission for v0.4.0 requires later learning and promotion controls to remain explicit.

capabilities.promise: Records one bounded capability contract with status, promise, non-promise, owner, interface, evidence, version, and contradiction refusal.
capabilities.non_promise: Does not create evidence, grant approval, implement a capability, or resolve a conflict merely by recording it.
capabilities.approval_reference: accountable-human R40-00 implementation review accepted 2026-07-16; unreleased candidate only; no C4 release authorization
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Forbid the affected claim and produce a bounded decision brief when a record, interface, evidence item, or release statement conflicts.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: No v0.4.0 capability is publicly permitted until its exact implementation, evidence, accountable-human admission, and final release decision are complete.

capabilities.promise: Distinguishes exact current installation and release statements from retained historical candidate, gate, and evidence snapshots.
capabilities.non_promise: Will not treat a candidate branch, historical gate, or old release note as a current release.

identifiers: R40-01 current and historical release record repair

capabilities.approval_reference: accountable-human R40-01 implementation review accepted 2026-07-16; unreleased candidate only; no C4 release authorization
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Do not update current installation guidance until exact release identity and historical labels are reviewed.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: Verified unreleased candidate only. It remains release_disposition candidate and public_claim_status forbidden until a future exact-release admission and C4 decision.

capabilities.promise: Records optional human-approved bounded execution scope, inputs, tools, outputs, expiry, stop conditions, and approver.
capabilities.non_promise: Does not grant autonomy, execute work, advance project state, data access, or replace human approval automatically.
capabilities.approval_reference: accountable-human C2 and batch C3 accepted 2026-07-16; accountable-human R40-02 implementation review accepted 2026-07-16; no C4 release authorization
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Refuse an incomplete, expired, out-of-scope, prohibited, or unapproved bounded execution request.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: Verified unreleased candidate only. It has no executor, tool grant, data authority, or public claim until later exact-release admission and C4 decision.

capabilities.promise: Explicitly excludes named specialist role cards and agent runtime from v0.4.0.
capabilities.non_promise: Does not provide an agent runtime, tool grant, delegated authority, hidden background work, or mandatory multi-agent deployment.
capabilities.approval_reference: accountable-human C2 and batch C3 accepted 2026-07-16; accountable-human R40-03 implementation review accepted 2026-07-17; no C4 release authorization
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Do not describe a role card as an operating agent or permission grant.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: v0.4 exclusion is verified locally. A future role-card capability requires a separate named-role design, evidence, human review, exact-release admission, and C4 decision.

capabilities.promise: Records generic source, restriction, ownership, sharing, and provenance metadata without accessing data content.
capabilities.non_promise: Will not access, copy, hash, clean, analyze, share, or certify real research or clinical data.

identifiers: R40-04 metadata-only data and provenance register

capabilities.approval_reference: accountable-human C2 and batch C3 accepted 2026-07-16; accountable-human R40-04 implementation review accepted 2026-07-17; no C4 release authorization
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: When a restriction, access, sharing, or online-service condition is unknown, stop copying, sharing, upload, or release actions.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: Verified only with synthetic metadata and refusal tests. It does not access data or establish ethics, consent, DUA, privacy, clinical, legal, or regulatory compliance; exact-release admission and C4 remain required.

capabilities.promise: Records candidate release-control decisions, material-review status, incident route, human acceptance boundaries, and post-release verification boundaries.
capabilities.non_promise: Will not certify security, legal, institutional, rights, or compliance sufficiency.
capabilities.approval_reference: accountable-human C2 and batch C3 accepted 2026-07-16; accountable-human R40-05 implementation review accepted 2026-07-17; no C4 release authorization
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Do not release when material review, secret review, rights status, or accountable-human approval is unknown or incomplete.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: Verified only with synthetic record and refusal tests. Candidate review is not C4 authorization, C4 is not post-release verification, and no GitHub setting, tag, Release, scan, signing, or certification was performed; exact-release admission and C4 remain required.

capabilities.promise: Exercises verified-candidate or explicitly excluded v0.4.0 records and supported profiles using empty or synthetic inputs with documented refusal cases.
capabilities.non_promise: Will not prove scientific validity, clinical readiness, universal safety, or institutional compliance.
capabilities.approval_reference: accountable-human C2 and batch C3 accepted 2026-07-16; accountable-human R40-06 implementation review accepted 2026-07-17; no C4 release authorization
capabilities.contradiction_refusal: Do not combine candidate-only test evidence with a release, runtime parity, or compliance claim.
capabilities.limitations_and_next_action: Verified only as unreleased-candidate synthetic assurance. It does not prove scientific, clinical, ethics, DUA, legal, security, installation, or release correctness; exact-release admission, clean-commit rerun, and C4 remain required.
